description: Returns everything a local messaging orchestrator (e.g. a Beeper MCP client) needs to sync conversations into this CRM: the current sync watermark, the tracking blacklist, the mapping/memory rules, tenant/owner context, and available_agents — the tenant's active specialized agents (id, name, description), queried live every call (never stale), plus agent_routing_hint explaining how to tag a matching conversation to one via memory (no auto-delegation). Call this first each run.
name: get_ingest_instructions
